name: ClickSend
summary: SMS and messaging platform for businesses.

flows.title: Send a quick SMS
steps: Open Quick SMS in the Dashboard. Quick SMS reaches as many as 1,000 contacts without setting up a full campaign.
Add a number, or search your contact lists, in the To field.
In the From field select the type of number or sender to send from.
Write the SMS, or use one of your pre-built templates.
Select Now to send it immediately, or Later to schedule it.
Click Preview and Confirm to see what the send will cost, then click Send.

flows.title: Set up an SMS template
steps: In the Dashboard go to SMS, then Templates.
Name the template for quick reference and write the message.
Optional: personalise the template by adding merge tags or placeholders.
Click Add. Templates can be created from Quick SMS, SMS Campaign and Messenger too, and edited or deleted from the templates page afterwards.
